conditions.displayName: More than 20,000 document reads in an hour

documentation.subject: Roadside: Firestore reads spike
documentation.content:
Firestore served more than 20,000 document reads in an hour. The free tier is 50,000 a day, so this pace costs money and usually means a listener in a loop (an app rebuilding a stream), a missing `limit()`, or scraping.

Check Firebase console, Firestore, Usage, for the collection, and whether a release just went out (docs/runbooks/rollback.md). Tune the threshold after launch week (#62).
